memo_delta.summary: The Watchlist remains unresolved before October 23. Q2 falsified the EBITDA no-beat and strict-leverage-rise forecasts; reported CFO recovered, while matched vendor DSO and the second margin print remain open.
memo_delta.stage_one_comment: The original recommendation was Watchlist with no position. A matched review-date price was not verified, and price direction cannot prove the thesis. The second-quarter adjusted EBITDA beat falsified the no-clear-beat forecast. The official interim report also shows strict net leverage below the original threshold, falsifying the forecast of a further rise, and reported operating cash flow recovered. Those disconfirming facts weaken the original operating caution. The vendor receivable-days metric has not been matched, so the full cash-quality question remains open. The two-print margin test still needs the October 23 results. Older Qatalum news is not treated as a current update because it was crawled recently. Keep watching the next filing and the unresolved ownership cap before changing the recommendation.
